lines.text: A Met Gala ticket now costs a hundred thousand dollars.
The museum steps. The flashbulbs. A gown everyone talks about.
Last year it was seventy-five thousand.
A table of ten: three hundred fifty thousand, usually paid by a brand.
Stars prep at the Mark hotel. Penthouses: forty-five thousand a night.
Custom couture? Some estimates put a gown at five hundred thousand.
Ticket plus that suite: a hundred forty-five thousand. Before the dress.
But most stars don't buy the dress. Brands lend it. Who's really paying?
